summary:
Automatic area route availability upon detecting deactivated reader accounts:
- Implemented isReaderAccountDeactivated helper in routes.ts checking terminated, inactive, deactivated, rejected, suspended, revoked, disabled, or locked states
- calculateLocationOccupancies automatically excludes deactivated readers, releasing their assigned routes
- DatabaseHelper.updateLocalReaderStatus clears assignedRoutes when setting status to terminated/rejected and preserves history in previousAssignedRoutes
- LoginScreen immediately synchronizes via WebSockets on account termination and marks released routes as Available
- Tested and verified in TC-MOB-04 (All 8 tests passing)
